verdict.rationale: React is a client-side UI library with no hosted service, accounts, or API surface of its own to authenticate against. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is therefore a category error for this kind of product, not an unmet capability. The pack's OpenAPI probe found no API spec at any candidate path, which is consistent with this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
